semantic_reason: Issue #939 reports an actual crash (Absinthe.SerializationError: Value nil is not a valid boolean) when an input-object argument has a partial default value (e.g. %{}), causing introspection queries to raise a 500. The patch modifies existing rendering logic in introspection.ex (adding Map.take to only render fields present in the default map), changing existing behavior to correct the reported failure. This is a defect fix, not a new feature.
delegation_note: Defect-semantics review remains agent-delegated; patch minimization was separately confirmed by the human dataset curator on 2026-09-12.
